text:
Maya: Morning — quick heads-up: we're aiming to lock SDK + docs + sample apps by EOD Thu for this release. Please post last blockers and owners.

Leo: Python SDK auth fix is in progress, PR https://git.redwood/rdw/sdk/pulls/432 — needs a quick review (token refresh edge case).

Ash: Sample app e2e is flaky on CI (random auth handshake failure). Reproduced locally once. Tagging @Sam to help triage.

Sam: On it. Looks like a 5s timeout in the test runner. I'll run a serial rerun and try bumping the wait to 15s. ETA ~2h.

Olivia: Docs need two final screenshots and the quickstart flow wording updated (auth section). Who can verify copy and run the sample?

Leo: The SDK change is tiny — swap the refresh header:
```
headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token.get_access_token()}"
```
I'll add a comment in the PR.

CI Bot: CI pipeline failed: sample-app-integration (logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/789). Failing job: sample-app-e2e.

Ash: If we can't stabilize that flaky test by 3pm, fallback plan: quarantine the test (mark flaky) and ship the sample app without it. Add note in changelog about quarantined test and follow-up ticket.

Maya: Agree. Need explicit owners for the smoke run and final verifications: Sam (sample app smoke), Olivia (docs screenshots + quickstart text), Leo (SDK auth). Can everyone ack?

Sam: Ack. I'll add smoke script and post results to thread. Command I'll run: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --env=staging --quick`

Olivia: Ack. I'll update screenshots and push the PR with the wording change — will link once done.

Leo: Ack — I'll pair with a reviewer (Ash or Maya) for a fast approve once CI is green. :thumbsup:

Docs Bot: Auto: created draft release-note in https://docs.redwood/releases/drafts/1 by Maya.

Maya: I'll draft the release notes and include the quarantined test note if needed. Also planning a short postmortem item for the flaky e2e.

Ash: Quick dependencies check — sample app depends on sdk@v1.12.0-rc and quickstart scripts in docs repo. If SDK doesn't cut, we should point sample app at the RC branch and note it in release notes.

Maya: Good call. Leo, if SDK slips, please create a patch branch and we will pin sample app to it.

Leo: Will do. If anything blocks, I’ll ping here.

Sam: Smoke run started (logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/790). Will post pass/fail in ~15m.

Maya: Thanks team — if no major surprises, I'll lock the changelog at 17:00 PT and tag release candidate. Otherwise we'll reconvene in this thread.

Sam: Smoke passed ✅ — all quick checks green. Posting artifacts now.

Maya: Awesome. Olivia, Leo — please push final PRs and @release-team when ready.

Leo: PR merged, SDK release candidate tagged.

Olivia: Docs PR merged and screenshots uploaded.

Maya: Locking changelog now and notifying #release-notes. Great work everyone.

Ash: Noted follow-up: create ticket for flaky e2e investigations and increase test timeouts on a best-effort basis.

Maya: Filed ticket RDW-2041 for flaky-e2e. Closing this sync — reach out if regressions show up. :rocket:
